import html # Template for the invitation (simple HTML structure) INVITATION_FORMAT = """

{event_title}

{event_description}

Date: {event_date}

{additional_notes}
""" def render_event_invitation( event_title: str, event_description: str, event_date: str, additional_notes: str ) -> str: """ Render a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- event_title : str The title of the event. event_description : str Full description (may contain line breaks). event_date : str Date of the event. additional_notes : str Any user-provided notes. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML ready for rendering on a web page. """ # Escape all user-provided content to avoid injection (CWE-74) safe_title = html.escape(event_title, quote=True) # Preserve line breaks in description by converting newlines to
safe_description = html.escape(event_description, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") safe_date = html.escape(event_date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(additional_notes, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_description=safe_description, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes=safe_notes )
